notes.title: Demo now playable on Mac!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We just updated our build so that mac users can also play the game! Please note the following:

[b]1）[/b]Altho the game can now be run on the mac system, please note we haven’t had the time to fully optimize it yet, therefor bugs n’ issues may occur. If they do, please let us know in the community section or via our socials!

[b]2）[/b]Currently the controller setup only works with wireless dualshock/windows controllers, not when it’s wired.

Thanks all!

notes.title: DEMO LIVE!!!!
notes.content:
Hi all!

The Game Festival is here and we hope you can come and check out our game! And please Wishlist if you do, it helps us a lot!

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/2AU4bzP

TWITTER: https://twitter.com/DEEPBOJ

EMAIL: DEEPBOJ@thinkingstars.com

Please see below for a few pointers about the game

1) The game is in an early stage and has a lot of work / time to go, however the core-gameplay is what you can expect for the full version.

2) Stuff like Voice Over which is super important for a space game like this will be added in the full game

3) Please give us feedback! See above how! The festival is a way for us to attract attention for a potential publisher and also to see what players think, and use that to improve the game!

4) If you like the game PLEASE wishlist! It's a lot of support for us, even if you don't know if you will eventually buy it or not :)
